qualification_requirements: source is official/public and accessible without paid credential or license
source can supply every required_new_data element assigned to it without semantic substitution
timestamps/publication or market timestamps support point-in-time causal ordering
coverage and granularity are sufficient for the grammar's already-frozen feature/window/lookback/target semantics
calendar/session semantics can be reconstructed without future information
source_rule.selection: Evaluate preregistered candidates only; accept any deterministic combination that proves all requirements. If multiple combinations qualify, choose lexicographically by normalized source-name tuple. If none qualify, FAIL_CLOSED_SOURCE_UNQUALIFIED.

qualification_requirements: data acquisition cost is zero under the preregistered official/free candidate restriction
existing frozen trading/execution cost contract, if any, remains unchanged and is merely carried forward
no new cost estimate, threshold, fee assumption or economic optimization may be inferred from outcomes
cost_rule.failure: If an applicable frozen execution-cost contract cannot be identified without creating or changing a scientific assumption, FAIL_CLOSED_COST_UNRESOLVED.
